summary: Complete initial source audit of all 162 Chinese units, six temporal or active-hint items, and three person records. The chapter names Guo Shoujing, Qi Luqian, and Li Qian in bibliographical discussion. Its two occurrences of zhi yuan are the title of the Calendar Classic, not dated events for any of those three people. The current extraction wrongly treats that title as the Yuan Zhiyuan reign and expands it into an AD 1264–1294 life/activity interval. No personal chronological event is supplied in this chapter.

findings.problem: The extraction mistakes the bibliographical title Zhi yuan Calendar Classic for a Yuan-era personal event and then turns it into an AD 1264–1294 interval for three different individuals.
findings.action: Remove the three title-derived temporal claims and their three active-date hints. Preserve the nondated bibliographical claims and three source-backed research holds. Rebuild the packet and obtain a new independent candidate review before canonical publication.
